# Load the libraries
```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(stars)
library(tmap)
```

# Load the data
```{r}
ej_screen <- sf::st_read(here::here("data", "ejscreen", "EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb")) |> filter(type == 'california')
```

```{r}
tm_shape(ej_screen)+
    tm_raster()+
    tm_crs('auto')
```
